Pl.Let Us Know Azeem' ka Alag Rehna Behter Sabit Hoga Ya Nahi?Irfana Azeem Ke ?liye Vafadar Rahegi Ya Nahi ? Unko Alag Karneme Hamaribhi Bhalai He Ke Nahi? Answer ID: 24597 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1600/1250/B=1431) The purpose of nikah for husband and wife is to fulfil their sexual desires and to develop the life of taqwa. It is not lawful for the parents of girl to keep her back at their home. It is necessary for them to send her to husband's house. However, she can visit her parents' home repeatedly to meet them. After marriage, her home is that of husband, she should stay there. If she wants to stay separately, the husband should make reasonable arrangement. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
